snippet.title: Moon River - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
FREE on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3392490/Moon_River/

Moon River is a short single-player exploration game made in RPG Maker 2003. Featuring a dark & quiet atmosphere, you play as a character called “The Mariner,” a lone sailor in a cursed world where shadows have swallowed the earth almost completely. Whatever remains is doomed to a quiet & inevitable erasure.

This release is an expanded and enhanced version of the original itch build. Made available for free for all to enjoy!
